answer: Use proof-of-work on identity renewal. Each account must solve a 20-second compute puzzle every epoch to stay eligible, with difficulty fixed per address. A 1,000-puppet farm burns about 5.5 CPU-hours per epoch, and puzzles can't be pooled. An honest agent pays 20 seconds. A script that must wander across puppets, or tends an orchard of fakes, pays linearly, so each voyage into the next epoch costs more fake identities than it earns.
